objective: Replace the retired Qwen3-VL 8B text-brain runtime with one pinned Qwen3.5 4B Q8_0 checkpoint, preserve M08-S21 adaptive reasoning on that same weight, reclaim unused Ollama model storage, and update the canonical runtime and future offline QLoRA plan without changing the separate Cloud/local Vision boundary.
non_goals: Do not start M09 game control, M10 livestream adapters or M11 training in this slice.
Do not train or mutate model weights during normal conversation.
Do not load a second text-brain checkpoint automatically or route text turns to Cloud Vision.
Do not rewrite historical M08 evidence that accurately records the former 8B baseline.
contracts: The only default local text checkpoint is qwen3.5:4b-q8_0 at the pinned Ollama manifest digest; Qwen3-VL 8B and the duplicate Qwen3.5 4B Q4 cache are absent after migration.
Qwen3.5 4B runs with an 8,192-token active context, full GPU offload request, a 6,144 MiB scheduler reservation, keep_alive=0 unless owner-pinned, and the existing ten-second turn deadline.
M08-S21 keeps ordinary viewer, emotional/contextual and game-analysis token budgets on this same checkpoint; private reasoning is never exposed to logs, memory, desktop or TTS.
Explicit screen understanding remains on the independently configured Cloud/light local Vision provider and contributes zero text-brain image payloads.

Future persona learning starts from the post-trained Hugging Face Qwen3.5-4B checkpoint with offline QLoRA SFT plus reviewed DPO/ORPO preference pairs; the Base checkpoint is not the default starting point and GGUF is never trained directly.
Proactive streamer behavior is planned as an event-driven initiative planner with bounded silence, recap, topic and interruption intents; it is not delegated to an always-proactive system prompt.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard-library text-brain stack, Ollama loopback runtime and repository documentation/provenance tooling.
oss_candidates: Qwen3.5-4B — https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B — Apache-2.0 — post-trained runtime and future owner-curated offline QLoRA base.
acceptance_criteria: The pinned Q8_0 tag is installed, reports Q8_0/4.7B, loads at 8,192 context with all 5,184,558,201 resident model bytes on GPU, and completes fast, emotional and game turns under ten seconds in the narrow local smoke.
Default config, startup bootstrap, resource status tests, README, provenance, notices and candidate manifests all name qwen3.5:4b-q8_0 and no active runtime path names the retired 8B tag.
Ollama list contains neither qwen3-vl:8b-thinking-q4_K_M nor the unused qwen3.5:4b Q4 tag after successful Q8 verification.
M08-S21 adaptive-budget tests, text-brain tests, resource-route tests, module-brief validation and git diff check pass.
Master Plan records the runtime migration, initiative-planner roadmap, post-trained QLoRA/DPO path, 9B manual benchmark-only policy and rollback-by-repull semantics.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S22-qwen35-4b-q8-runtime-migration-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s packages/text-brain/tests -p "test_*.py"
